concept: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
question: Which among the following elements behaves like alkali metals as well as halogens in its properties?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Hydrogen.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hydrogen behaves like alkali metals as it has one electron in its outermost shell, which it readily loses to form a cation.**
 
• Hydrogen also behaves like halogens as it can share its electrons with other elements to form a covalent bond.
 
• This property of hydrogen is due to its position in the periodic table, where it is placed above the alkali metals and halogens.
 
• Helium and neon are noble gases and do not exhibit properties of either alkali metals or halogens.
 
• Lithium behaves like an alkali metal, but not like a halogen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Neon is a noble gas **and does not readily react with other elements to form compounds.
 
• ** Helium is the second lightest element** and is used in balloons, airships, and cooling systems.
 
• **Lithium is a soft, silvery-white metal** that is highly reactive and is used in batteries, ceramics, and pharmaceuticals.
